analysis.reason: 최근 5거래일 연속 하락세(-8.41% 포함)로 RSI가 34.3까지 하락하며 과매도 구간에 진입했습니다. ADX가 23.2로 추세 형성 초기 단계에 머물러 있어 방향성이 불확실합니다. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 0.39배로 위축되어 있어 추가 하락 시 매수 관점에서 접근하기 어렵습니다.
analysis.reasonEn: The price has fallen for the last 5 consecutive trading days (including -8.41%), pushing RSI down to 34.3 into oversold territory. ADX remains in the early stages of trend formation at 23.2, indicating uncertain direction. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.39x the 5-day average, making it difficult to approach from a buy perspective on further declines.

analysis.continuityEn: Maintaining a 'watch and see' stance for 4 consecutive days. Compared to the previous record, RSI has fallen from 40.2 to 34.3, entering oversold territory. However, ADX has slightly increased from 20.6 to 23.2, remaining in the early stages of trend formation, thus the stance is maintained.
